3.  25-55205  Recommendation to receive and file a staff report on the requirements and
  guidance provided to City of Long Beach candidates regarding the use of public
  service announcements during campaign season.

  A motion was made by Commissioner De Benedictis, seconded by
  Commissioner Wise, to approve recommendation, as amended, to request
  staff draft a memo providing the Mayor and City Council clear and updated
  guidance related to campaign-season communication practices, with a focus
  on ensuring ethical and transparent use of public resources; in the following
  areas for guidance and development; [1] use of digital and social media
  content by elected officials and City departments during election periods, [2]
  public service announcements (PSAs) created by outside organizations,
  including labor unions and advocacy groups; [3] Campaign-related tagging,
  mentions, or promotion on City-affiliated platforms; with [4] the objective
  being to establish clear, enforceable parameters prior to the next election
  cycle that promote fairness, safeguard the public’s trust, and uphold the
  ethical separation between City resources and campaign activities. The
  motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  7  Añorve, De Benedictis, Morales, Shotwell, Wise, Coleman, Pollack
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
